title: Verify: BootScene has a single SceneObject import unit tests
summary: Unit test fails while a duplicate SceneObject import exists
description: Add a vitest unit test reading BootScene.ts source text and asserting a single SceneObject import, so it fails when the duplicate is present.
acceptance_criteria: Given the duplicate import is present, when the test runs, then it fails.
Given ACT1 is applied, when the test runs, then it passes.
technical_constraints: Reads the source file only; no app, server or browser started
definition_of_done: Test added and passing after ACT1

steps.action: Create the test file. Read ../src/phaser/BootScene.ts with readFileSync (node:fs, utf8) via fileURLToPath(new URL(...)). Test 1 'imports SceneObject exactly once': count matches of /^import type \{ SceneObject \}/gm and expect length toBe(1). Test 2 'still imports createPhaserRenderContext': expect source toContain("import { createPhaserRenderContext } from './renderContext';").
steps.code:
const matches = src.match(/^import type \{ SceneObject \}/gm) ?? [];
expect(matches).toHaveLength(1);
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneSingleImport.test.ts
steps.expected: Both tests pass after ACT1; test 1 fails with length 2 if the duplicate import is restored.
